summary: Learn how to close the digital gender divide with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with the tools to promote gender equality in technology.
lede: Gender and technology training examines how barriers in access, skills, design, and decision-making shape participation in digital systems. It is for professionals who design, manage, or fund technology initiatives and need to assess gender gaps and make programs more inclusive. Learners practice using gender-disaggregated data, applying human-centered design, and setting indicators to track digital inclusion and impact.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals who design, manage, or fund technology-driven initiatives and want to ensure gender inclusivity in their work, including:
audience: Program and project managers in NGOs
Government officials in ICT, education, or economic
Researchers and educators in STEM and gender
Anyone committed to inclusive technology and equitable
modules: Assessing and Measuring Digital Gender Gaps
Policy and Governance for Inclusive Technology
Building Women’s Participation in STEM and ICT
Digital Entrepreneurship and Women’s Economic Empowerment
